notes.title: Mac and Linux Version;Controller Support;Score Bug Fix
notes.content:
Greetings Space Wars Community,

We are excited to announce we have updated Space Wars again. We have added a Mac and Linux Version, Controller Support, and fixed the Score Bug Glitch that would only allow high-scores of the top 4 regional scores to be posted to global leader-boards. Now all scores will be posted to global leader-boards as long as you are in top 1000 players and top 4 regional players will show up in regional section. Any questions, comments, or fixes email us at star.studios.1a@gmail.com. Cheers! 


Space Wars Team

notes.title: Leaderboards
notes.content: To see your high score compared to others around the world Check out leaderboards at: https://www.star-studios.space/leaderboards/

notes.title: Tell Us what you Think
notes.content: Please take the time to tell us what you think about space wars either by review or comment so we can make a game that everybody likes. For instance what do you think about the new normal and hard difficulties?

notes.title: Fixed Bugs and Added New Powerup
notes.content: Fixed Bugs that made the game unplayable. Both difficulties normal and hard should now be alot more fun and playable. Also we added a new powerup the laser for the normal mode. Enjoy!!!!!

notes.title: Free Keys for Reviewers and Press
notes.content: We are giving out free keys for reviewers and press on the condition that you use it to review the game Space Wars. If not they will be revoked. For more information contact star.studios.1a@gmail.com or send us a message.

notes.title: New Difficulty
notes.content: As requested by new players we have made a normal difficulty. It is easier than the original difficulty with bigger and more colorful bullets and fewer enemies for players who thought the game was impossible at the beginning. The original difficulty we have classified as hard and is still playable.

notes.title: Level 3 Update; DLC (Level 4 Preview, Story, Ship Selection)
notes.content:
We have just released level 3 Update. It includes new ships, backgrounds, music, and much more. Also we released a trailer for a level 4 which also has new ships, bosses, backgrounds, and music. In addition we are going to package a dlc which will include level 4 with a ton more story to the game and also an option to upgrade your ship by using score points. This dlc will be released in the next month or so. Stay updated by checking back peroidically. If 
you have any questions or comments email us at star.studios.1a@gmail.com. 

Happy gaming!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!

notes.title: Level 2 Update
notes.content: We just released level 2 for Space Wars!!!! It has major updates with new enemy ships, new bosses, and new strategies. As promised we will also be releasing level 3 in a few weeks time as well with huge updates!!!! Keep updated by checking back periodically. Enjoy!!!!!
